scope: Three subsequent bounded live shards, one independently reviewed DOCX export/context shard, one independently reviewed partial native-skill shard, and one scoped postboot text request. Historical shards retain their original outcomes. Does not replace FACTS.json, the original zero-execution baseline, or the full private acceptance matrix.

subsequent_docx_export_and_context.artifact: A genuine DOCX was received and downloaded through the receiving bot. Its exact hash matched the existing own-profile artifact; that source artifact's bytes and metadata remained unchanged during the export.
subsequent_docx_export_and_context.semantic_and_context_checks: Bounded package inspection confirmed the requested content. The caption was correct; both exchanges persisted in the same native conversation. A natural follow-up recalled the earlier deadline without receiving that deadline again.
subsequent_docx_export_and_context.limits: This is a fresh export and follow-up. It does not retroactively accept the earlier undownloaded attachment, establish a complete create/edit/revise journey, or prove that the model reread the DOCX binary.

subsequent_native_skill_persistence.evidence_scope: Actual native calls and scope receipts agree with the exact published inert skill, its patch and durable ledger. Two initial validation failures remain recorded. This establishes native persistence, not later retrieval.
subsequent_native_skill_persistence.artifact_boundary: The raw reply contains a DOCX and caption. The frozen text-only observer stopped before downloading it; this is an observation limitation, not proof of semantic product failure or external artifact-content acceptance.
subsequent_native_skill_persistence.preservation: The created skill and original failures remain. No retry, repeated creation, advance or retrospective delivery acceptance was used.
subsequent_native_skill_persistence.precision_correction: The raw caption is the exact prefix of the native final text; a trailing transport directive is present only in the native text. Literal full-text equality is not claimed.

observed_successes: Own-profile preference was written, replaced and recalled in the same existing conversation. Fresh-context retrieval and cross-user isolation are not established.

A small natural-Russian dialogue and a precise arithmetic answer were independently corroborated from receiving-bot messages and native persistence. This does not establish the complete personality or human-client UX.
A missing-source reply kept the document contents unconfirmed and requested clarification. An access refusal and filtered zero history matches do not prove that the document does not exist.
A colloquial follow-up received a history-grounded summary, including the previously created letter and its deadline. This does not establish the delivered letter binary.

first_failures_preserved.details: Provider output was refused by the keyless text boundary; failed-call publication also failed. Original provider type and length were not retained, so a specific oversized output is not retrospectively asserted. Dependent web steps were not sent.

The product created two own-profile DOCX files and emitted an actual document message. The text-only observer refused the unexpected attachment before downloading it. That observer refusal is not a product send failure; native file creation and wire metadata are not binary delivery acceptance.
Internal English verifier instructions and operation/error vocabulary reached a document caption and later text replies. Truthful failure reporting does not make this suitable user-facing language.

offline_credit_correction.details: The offline helper exercised legacy repository modules rather than the isolated installed native product. Those observations remain legacy-only. A fixed character-per-token heuristic is not a measured tokenizer/template result.

accounting_corrections: Actual sends are 4, 5 and 2, rather than planned scenario lengths.
Native conversation persistence and own-profile preference/file writes are product effects; a broad unchanged-database or empty-effects statement is incorrect.
One previously reported per-step wait was not the duration of the complete memory journey.
Declared deadline and resource-enforcement deviations remain in the private original evidence; this publication makes no timing qualification claim.

source_candidate_state.meaning: Reviewed source candidates remain separate from observed installed behavior. No previous PASS transfers to their future installed bytes.

excluded_materials: Bot, account, session and case identifiers
User prompts, expected answers and private acceptance definitions
Operational paths, private evidence references, raw captures, database rows and handoffs
Credentials, tokens, personal data and runnable deployment instructions

postboot_tool_maintenance_20261021.deployment: The exact independently reviewed standalone tool was installed atomically with a fresh rollback source and existing exclusive custody.

current_postboot_product_state.shared_blocker: The replaced embedding backend/API pair is stopped and its existing endpoint is not published. Coordination with ongoing owner maintenance remains pending.

Historical offset-only replay can run preflight and preserve a STOPPED result on rejection; blanket zero-API/write behavior is not claimed.

fresh_authorized_text_request.artifact: No document was received in this step; the natural report request did not explicitly require a file. No artifact acceptance is inferred.

remaining_skill_journey.limits: Formatting an answer from existing conversation context does not establish a fresh read of the stored skill. Prior native publication remains accepted; it was not repeated.

external_model_metadata.limits: Authenticated metadata alone is not inference qualification; the advertised larger auxiliary context has not been activated in the installed profile.

postboot_supported_recovery_and_first_te.separate_visible_gap: The group-room background worker was refused by the user-scope boundary. Room operations remain unqualified; this was not treated as proof that ordinary Telegram chat could not run.
postboot_supported_recovery_and_first_te.diagnostic_limits: Non-native diagnostic invocation and source/API-version mismatches were preserved as diagnostic failures.
